items.name: Take a Break Ohio State 2023

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

venue.name: [Ohio Union](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: Friday: Student-Alumni Council Room (2nd Floor), Saturday: Ohio Staters, Inc. Traditions Room (2nd Floor)

items.information:
This competition is on a Friday evening and Saturday, and will only feature Side Events and Blind Events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

**Friday, March 17th - Student-Alumni Council Room** 

*FMC (Fewest Moves Challenge)*


**Saturday, March 18th - Ohio Staters, Inc. Traditions Room**

*6x6
 7x7
 Square-1
 Clock
 3BLD
 4BLD
 5BLD
 3x3 Multi-Blind*

items.name: Bothell Spring Open 2023

venue.name: Bothell United Methodist Church
venue.details: Fellowship Hall—first door to the right upon entry

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BothellSpringOpen2023#24448-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BothellSpringOpen2023#24447-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
